covers: First-person narrative with an admission in it — the format most at risk of being sanded into generic motivational copy.
idea: Tell the story of my first day in a gym: I walked in, did twenty minutes on a bike facing the wall, and left without touching a weight because I did not know where anything was and was sure everyone was watching. Took me a month to go back.

hooks.text: I'm on a bike facing a wall, and I've been there twenty minutes.
hooks.rationale: Drops into the middle of the moment, present tense, no setup.

hooks.text: You've done the lap. Walked in, looked around, walked out.
hooks.rationale: Names the exact thing the viewer did last week.

hooks.text: Nobody was watching me. That was the part I got wrong.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the belief the whole story is built on.

hooks.text: It took me a month to work out what actually stopped me that day.
hooks.rationale: Opens the gap on the reason without closing it.

hooks.text: The first day is the only genuinely hard one.
hooks.rationale: The strongest true version of the idea, stated flat.

sections.text: I'm on a bike facing a wall, and I've been there twenty minutes.
sections.on_screen_text: first day, still on the bike

sections.text: First day in a gym. I did not know where anything was, and I was certain everyone could tell.

So I left without touching a weight. Not because I could not lift anything. Because I could not work out where the thing I wanted was, and asking felt worse than leaving. Then it took me a month to go back, and the month was the expensive part, not the session I skipped.
Nobody is watching you. They are counting their own reps and thinking about their own hands.
If you did the lap and left, go back this week. Same door, same time.

claims.text: I left the first session without lifting anything.
It was a month before I went back.
claims.grounded_in: Took me a month to go back

voice_fidelity.evidence: Present-tense confession opener and "nobody is watching you" used where it lands, with the profile's short declaratives throughout.

hook_distinctiveness.evidence: A cold open, a named frustration, a reframe, an opened gap and a flat claim — five different entry points into the same story.

script_completeness.evidence: Filmable end to end, though the payoff carries the whole lesson and the body stays close to plot.

instruction_adherence.evidence: Every beat is in the idea, including the month, and no gym, city or person is named that the creator did not name.
